editorial.blurb: Chef Stephanie Izard's elevated diner concept delivers nostalgic comfort with creative flair, housed in a vibrant retro space that feels both welcoming and Instagram-worthy.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation and sit at the bar if you can—try the Sloppy Chicken Sammy, which reviewers describe as banh-mi meets po'boy, and arrive hungry enough to enjoy the generous fillings and crispy fries.
